title: Innocuous

inlines.v: INNOC'UOUS, adjective [Latin innocuus; in and noceo, to hurt.] Harmless; safe; producing no ill effect; innocent. Certain poisons used as medicines in small quantities, prove not only innocuous but beneficial. It applied only to things; not to persons.
